name: Damian Walshe-Howling
bio: Damian Walshe-Howling (born 22 January 1971) is an Australian actor.

credits.title: The Story of Wilfred
credits.overview: A feature-length documentary charting the history and legacy of Adam Zwar and Jason Gann's cult classic 'Wilfred' featuring interviews with cast and creatives involved in the series.

credits.title: Spa Weekend
credits.overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. credits.title: Just a Farmer
credits.overview: Alison, left to manage an ailing farm and an alcoholic father-in-law after her husband’s sudden death, navigates the challenges of rural life. The film explores generational trauma, love, loss, and the undeniable resilience of a farming community in the face of tragedy.

credits.title: Unspoken
credits.overview: As volatile protests for Croatian independence break out across the city of Sydney, Croatian born Marina is forced to expose a secretive love affair with her Australian boyfriend, as escalating political violence spills into her childhood home with devastating consequences.

credits.title: Darklands
credits.overview: When a policewoman fails to act at a shooting, an ambitious journalist will stop at nothing to exploit her story, exposing her family to the terrifying rage of a woman with nothing left to lose.

A lowly utility worker is called to the future by a mysterious radio signal. He must leave his dying wife to embark on a journey that will force him to face his deepest fears in an attempt to change the fabric of reality and save humankind from its greatest environmental crisis yet.

credits.title: Desert Dash
credits.overview: On the outskirts of Australia, opals are now the currency for survival in the game of Desert Dash. When a feisty heroine gets the opportunity to ‘Level Up’, there is no choice but to win.

credits.title: MESSiAH
credits.overview: In a playful collision of cultures, a hapless Irishman and his Parisian girlfriend get more than they bargained for when they encounter a particularly mischievous stranger in the spectacular Australian wilderness.

credits.title: Around the Block
credits.overview: A young Aboriginal boy is torn between his unexpected love of acting and the disintegration of his family.

credits.title: Mystery Road
credits.overview: A murdered girl is found under a bridge on a remote road and indigenous detective Jay Swan gets the case. Jay finds that no-one is that interested in solving the murder of an indigenous teenager and he is forced to work alone.

credits.title: Summer Suit
credits.overview: It's summer in the country town of Euroa, 1987. A 10-year-old girl with epilepsy gets a new sense of identity when she discovers a discarded two-piece suit in her brothers' bedroom closet.

credits.title: Suspended
credits.overview: Confronted by the stark reality that his father is in an intimate relationship with another woman, seven-year-old Caleb grapples with his sense of belonging and begins to inhabit a realm of frightening magical possibility. credits.title: Monkeys
credits.overview: Friendship is tested when a guy realizes his mate has gone and copied his haircut. Will he confront his true emotions?

credits.title: Panic at Rock Island
credits.overview: An island in spectacular Sydney Harbour. Summer sun,  top international artists, and tens of thousands of music fans from across the world!  Idyllic...until unimaginable disaster strikes.

credits.title: The Reef
credits.overview: A great white shark hunts the crew of a capsized sailboat along the Great Barrier Reef.

credits.title: Insignia
credits.overview: The once celebrated graphic designer Paul Andrews has fallen from grace. Battling against the demands of vacuous clients, deprived of his voice, he descends into an obsessive and distorted search for creative expression.

credits.title: Macbeth
credits.overview: Macbeth, loyal to his crime boss, Duncan, is told by witches that he will one day take over. Driven by their prophecy, he and his wife plot to kill Duncan, and takes the leadership of the gang for himself. credits.title: Rupture
credits.overview: One man is tested to breaking point as the repercussions of a single fearsome choice lead him down a path of unbearable darkness, from which there can be no coming back. Some things taken can never be returned. Some things broken, never mended.

credits.title: Josh Jarman
credits.overview: Marcus Graham plays Josh Jarman, a struggling playwright who has written a long, serious play about doomed love, failed relationships and the overall hurt and heartache of falling in love. He is extremely proud of it, and takes it to various producers around the city, hoping to find one that will produce his play.

credits.title: Courts mais Gay : Tome 5
credits.overview: A collection of gay short films. The 7 short films are: Next Door Man [Ο άνδρας της διπλανής πόρτας...] (2001); Saturn's Return (2001); Love, Always... [Amour, Toujours...] (1995); Dream Kitchen (1999); Far West (2003); The Whiz Kids [Freunde] (2001); W (2003).

credits.title: He Died with a Felafel in His Hand
credits.overview: A search for love, meaning and bathroom solitude. Danny goes through a series of shared housing experiences in a succession of cities on the east coast of Australia. Together these vignettes form a narrative that is surprisingly reflective.

credits.title: Saturn's Return
credits.overview: Two young man in love, Barney and Dimi, are on a trip to visit Dan, Barney's dying father. Dan is planning his suicide and wants Barney there.

credits.title: A Wreck, a Tangle
credits.overview: A wired but charming and educated junkie couple ("we prefer the term chemically dependent") run their stolen car into a nice well to do thirty-something couple and when it gets all too hard, end up staying with them - first for a night, then a week and then for way too long.
